name: LipSurf
summary: Navigate browser pages, dictate text, and invoke commands using a microphone and a Chrome extension.
summary_zh: 用麦克风和 Chrome 扩展浏览网页、输入文本并执行命令。
devices: Chrome on Windows, macOS, Linux or Chromebook
requirements: Free daily allowance; paid unlimited plan
evidence_note: Developer describes supported platforms and voice commands.
steps: Use its command help to navigate.

name: macOS Vocal Shortcuts
summary: Associate a trained word or custom sound with a chosen Mac action.
summary_zh: 把训练过的词语或自定义声音关联到指定的 Mac 操作。
evidence_note: Apple describes custom utterances and on-device recognition.
steps: Repeat the chosen utterance during setup.

name: macOS Voice Control
summary: Use spoken commands to open apps, click controls, scroll pages, and dictate text on a Mac.
summary_zh: 通过口述命令在 Mac 上打开应用、点击控件、滚动页面和输入文字。
evidence_note: Apple documents commands and the built-in tutorial.
limitations: Standard Dictation is unavailable while Voice Control runs.
steps: Enable Voice Control in Accessibility settings.
Use Show Commands to discover actions.

name: Parrot.py
summary: Train personally chosen clicks, chirps, or other non-speech sounds to trigger keyboard and mouse actions.
summary_zh: 训练自己选择的点击声、啾声等非语音声音，用来触发键盘和鼠标操作。
evidence_note: README documents recording, training and playback.

name: Talon
summary: Operate desktop software through spoken commands and short mouth sounds; optionally combine them with gaze pointing.
summary_zh: 用语音命令和简短口腔声音操作桌面软件，也可配合眼动指针。
requirements: Free speech engine; optional paid Talon+
evidence_note: Official installation and input documentation.
limitations: Eye pointing needs compatible tracking hardware.

name: VoiceAttack
summary: Turn spoken phrases into game controls, application shortcuts, and multi-step macros.
summary_zh: 把口述短语变成游戏控制、应用快捷键和多步骤宏。
requirements: Paid registration beyond the limited free trial
evidence_note: Developer manual describes profiles and command actions.
steps: Test the command in its target application.

name: Windows Voice Access
summary: Control Windows and compose text with speech recognition that runs locally after its language model is downloaded.
summary_zh: 下载语言模型后，通过本地语音识别控制 Windows 和输入文字。
evidence_note: Microsoft documents setup and the interactive guide.
steps: Enable Voice Access in Accessibility settings.
Download the language and configure microphone.

name: Android Camera Switches
summary: Map facial gestures to scanning and selection actions, using a phone's front camera as switch input.
summary_zh: 把面部动作映射为扫描和选择操作，将手机前置摄像头用作开关输入。
evidence_note: Google documents gesture assignments and setup.
limitations: Cannot operate alongside other camera apps.
steps: Choose Camera Switch and assign gestures.
Adjust gesture size and hold time.

name: EyeGestures Demo
summary: Run a webcam gaze-calibration example as a starting point for a custom gaze interface.
summary_zh: 运行基于摄像头的视线校准示例，作为开发自定义眼动界面的起点。
evidence_note: README documents package installation and example execution.
steps: Calibrate at the documented viewing distance.

name: EyeHarp
summary: Play a musical instrument by selecting notes with gaze; head tracking or another pointer can also control it.
summary_zh: 通过目光选择音符来演奏乐器，也可使用头部追踪或其他指针设备。
requirements: Separate Tobii eye tracker for gaze
Free basic piano; paid full edition
evidence_note: Developer FAQ explains installation, trackers and editions.
steps: Install and activate the emailed key.
Connect the tracker and choose an instrument.

name: EyeMine 2
summary: Control Minecraft with a gaze-operated onscreen interface for movement, building, and mining.
summary_zh: 通过眼动操作的屏幕界面控制 Minecraft 中的移动、建造和采矿。
evidence_note: SpecialEffect specifies the supported game and input setup.
limitations: Not a console or mobile Minecraft solution.
steps: Install EyeMine and the supported Minecraft version.

name: GazePlay
summary: Play small games using eye movement through an eye tracker that controls the pointer.
summary_zh: 通过能控制指针的眼动仪，用目光玩小游戏。
evidence_note: Project site provides downloads and tracker requirements.

name: iPhone Eye Tracking
summary: Use the front camera to move a focus pointer with your eyes and select controls by dwelling.
summary_zh: 使用前置摄像头跟踪视线，通过停留选择屏幕控件。
outcome_zh: 注视选择 iPhone 控件
evidence_note: Apple documents calibration and dwell selection.
steps: Look at a control to dwell-select.

name: Look to Speak
summary: Select prepared phrases or pictures with eye movements and have the phone speak the selection.
summary_zh: 用眼睛动作选择预设短语或图片，让手机朗读选择的内容。
evidence_note: Google listing describes selection and on-device processing.
limitations: Selects prepared content rather than unrestricted dictation.
steps: Use eye movements to select a phrase.

name: OptiKey
summary: Select an onscreen keyboard and desktop controls with gaze, dwell, or a compatible switch; composed text can be spoken aloud.
summary_zh: 通过注视、停留或兼容开关选择屏幕键盘和桌面控件，也能朗读输入的文字。
evidence_note: Version matrix documents hardware compatibility changes.
limitations: Version 4 drops several older Tobii trackers; check compatibility.

name: Project Gameface
summary: Combine head movement with facial gestures to move a cursor and trigger configured actions.
summary_zh: 结合头部运动与面部动作移动光标并触发配置的操作。
evidence_note: Google archived the repository on September 5, 2025.

name: WebGazer Ball Collision Demo
summary: Move an orange ball toward a blue target with estimated gaze in a browser demonstration.
summary_zh: 在浏览器演示中，用估计的注视位置引导橙色球靠近蓝色目标。
evidence_note: Project page links the gaze game and calibration guidance.
limitations: Updates are not guaranteed from February 2026.

name: AITrack
summary: Estimate head position from a webcam and send it to opentrack for compatible simulator controls.
summary_zh: 用摄像头估计头部位置，并发送给 opentrack 控制兼容模拟器的视角。
outcome_zh: 摄像头模拟器头部追踪
evidence_note: README documents opentrack integration and camera requirements.
steps: Configure opentrack to receive its UDP output.
Start both programs and center tracking.

name: Body Synth
summary: Make music by moving your body in front of a webcam; optionally speak commands to change chords or instruments.
summary_zh: 在摄像头前移动身体来创作音乐，也可通过语音改变和弦或乐器。
evidence_note: Creator's experiment page explains movement and voice controls.
limitations: Camera framing and sensitivity need adjustment.
steps: Launch the experiment and allow camera access.

name: Enable Viacam
summary: Translate head motion into pointer movement using an ordinary webcam, with dwell clicking available.
summary_zh: 使用普通摄像头把头部运动转成指针移动，并可通过停留点击。
evidence_note: Official site provides downloads and configuration guidance.
limitations: Published Windows requirements list older releases; verify your system.

name: macOS Head Pointer
summary: Move the Mac pointer with head motion captured by a camera, pairing it with a chosen alternative click action.
summary_zh: 通过摄像头捕捉头部运动来移动 Mac 指针，并搭配其他点击方式。
evidence_note: Apple describes head movement and alternative clicking.
limitations: Pointer movement and clicking require separate configuration.
steps: Enable Head Pointer in Pointer Control.
Choose the camera and movement settings.

name: opentrack
summary: Turn head motion into view movement in compatible games, including a webcam-based neural-network input option.
summary_zh: 将头部运动转换为兼容游戏中的视角移动，也提供基于摄像头的神经网络输入。
evidence_note: Preserved project-wiki revision documents neural-network face tracking.
steps: Select neuralnet input and game output.
Start tracking and center the view.

name: SmoothTrack
summary: Use a phone camera as a head tracker for PC games through opentrack.
summary_zh: 通过 opentrack，把手机摄像头变成电脑游戏的头部追踪器。
evidence_note: Developer provides phone-to-PC setup instructions.
limitations: Phone compatibility varies; Android requires ARCore.
steps: Position the phone and start tracking.

name: Ultraleap TouchFree (legacy)
summary: Operate screen controls with tracked hand movement and hover or virtual-plane selection.
summary_zh: 通过手部追踪移动指针，并用悬停或虚拟平面操作屏幕控件。
evidence_note: Documentation survives; old source repository archived, current installer chain unresolved.
limitations: Installer links lead to a generic page or gateway error.
steps: Consult setup guide and confirm installer availability.
Connect the dedicated camera and run Camera Setup.
Choose and tune the interaction mode.

name: Makey Makey Piano and Scratch
summary: Connect conductive everyday objects to keyboard inputs, then use them to play a browser piano or control Scratch.
summary_zh: 把可导电的日常物件接成键盘输入，用来弹奏浏览器钢琴或控制 Scratch。
evidence_note: Manufacturer lesson demonstrates piano and Scratch.
steps: Open the piano or Scratch example.
Hold EARTH and touch connected inputs.

name: Paper Playground
summary: Arrange printed, encoded papers to control interactive web programs, sound, and other outputs through a camera.
summary_zh: 移动印有编码的纸张，通过摄像头控制交互式网页程序、声音及其他输出。
evidence_note: PhET project documents tangible programs and Creator.
steps: Move papers while viewing program output.

name: reacTIVision
summary: Track printed markers on physical objects and send their movement to TUIO clients or MIDI software.
summary_zh: 追踪实体物件上的打印标记，将运动信息发送给 TUIO 客户端或 MIDI 软件。
evidence_note: Project describes marker recognition and output protocols.
limitations: No bundled synthesizer or visualization engine.
steps: Connect a TUIO client or MIDI receiver.

name: JoyShockMapper
summary: Map a compatible controller's gyroscope to mouse aiming and configure flick-stick or motion bindings for PC games.
summary_zh: 把兼容手柄的陀螺仪映射为鼠标瞄准，并为电脑游戏配置 flick-stick 或动作绑定。
requirements: DualSense, DualShock 4, paired Joy-Cons, or Switch Pro Controller
evidence_note: Current official fork documents controllers and configuration.
steps: Load and calibrate a game configuration.

name: micro:bit Scratch Theremin
summary: Tilt a micro:bit to change musical pitch in a Scratch project.
summary_zh: 倾斜 micro:bit，在 Scratch 项目中改变音高。
evidence_note: Foundation tutorial supplies the project and connection guidance.
limitations: Uses board tilt, not hand distance.
steps: Set up Scratch Link and connect micro:bit.
Tilt forward and backward to change pitch.

name: Mobile Mouse Air Mouse
summary: Move an iPhone in the air to steer a computer pointer while holding an onscreen trigger.
summary_zh: 按住屏幕上的触发按钮，在空中移动 iPhone 来控制电脑指针。
outcome: A phone becomes an air mouse
evidence_note: Developer guide describes the Wi-Fi air-mouse workflow.
limitations: Separate server required for this workflow.
steps: Confirm the connection with trackpad mode.
Open Air Mouse and hold its trigger.

name: Intel ACAT
summary: Use configured switches or camera-based actuators to select a scanning keyboard and communicate through speech output.
summary_zh: 通过配置的开关或摄像头输入选择扫描式键盘，并用语音输出交流。
evidence_note: Intel provides the toolkit and actuator configuration.
limitations: Not every gesture is a supported actuator.
steps: Launch scanning and compose a message.

name: LipSync 4.1
summary: Combine a mouth-operated joystick with sip-and-puff inputs to control a mouse or gamepad through an open hardware hub.
summary_zh: 结合嘴部操作的摇杆与吸吹输入，通过开源硬件控制鼠标或游戏手柄。
evidence_note: Maintainer supplies hardware, firmware and build documentation.
limitations: Listed interface cable is currently unavailable.
steps: Build or request the documented hardware.
Connect the hub and choose a mode.

name: QuadStick Manager
summary: Configure sip-and-puff pressure thresholds and mappings for QuadStick's game and computer controls.
summary_zh: 配置 QuadStick 的吸吹压力阈值和映射，用来操作游戏与电脑。
requirements: QuadStick hardware; new units currently sold out
evidence_note: Manufacturer manual documents pressure settings; QMP 4 installer remains downloadable.
limitations: Vendor currently lists controller models sold out.
Actions depend on the selected profile.
steps: Connect QuadStick and open the Sip/Puff tab.
